rules.name: Annual travel credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $300 each account anniversary year for travel purchases, applied automatically. Qualifying purchases earn no points. Confirm your anniversary date in Chase before relying on the period.

rules.name: The Edit hotel credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $250 per booking and up to $500 each calendar year for prepaid stays of two or more nights booked through Chase Travel in The Edit. The page says "Starting 1/1/2026".

rules.name: Exclusive Tables dining credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $150 from January through June and up to $150 from July through December at restaurants in the OpenTable Exclusive Tables program. Delivery and gift cards do not qualify. The program runs through 06/30/2030.

rules.name: StubHub credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $150 from January through June and up to $150 from July through December at StubHub or viagogo. Activation required. Gift cards excluded. Available through 12/31/2027.

rules.name: Peloton membership credit
rules.eligibility_notes: $10 each month (up to $120 a calendar year) for eligible Peloton memberships. Activation required; app-store purchases do not qualify. Available through 12/31/2027.

rules.name: Lyft ride credit
rules.eligibility_notes: $10 in Lyft in-app credit each month for rides after adding the card in the Lyft app. Unused credit is forfeited. Available through 9/30/2027. The credit is applied in Lyft, so a card statement may not show its use.

rules.name: DoorDash promos
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $35 each month in DoorDash promotions ($15 plus two $10) with DashPass activated using this card. Promotions apply at checkout in DoorDash, not as statement credits. Available through 12/31/2029.

rules.name: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $120 every four years for the application fee, paid directly to the program or an eligible provider. Enter the four-year window yourself.

rules.name: The Shops at Chase credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Up to $250 in statement credits for purchases at The Shops at Chase after spending $75,000 on the card within a calendar year. The credit is "available for the remainder of the year in which the $75,000 was spent and through the next calendar year"; "no further action is needed to activate" it. The window starts on the day the threshold is met, so it needs your dates.

rules.name: Complimentary Apple TV and Apple Music subscriptions
rules.eligibility_notes: Subscription benefit, not a statement credit. Primary cardmember only. At least 12 months from activation. Activation must be completed by June 22, 2027. Cardmembers with a paid Apple One subscription receive an $8.00 monthly discount on Apple One instead. One-time activation on chase.com or the Chase Mobile app required by June 22, 2027. Primary cardmember only.

rules.name: Complimentary DoorDash DashPass membership
rules.eligibility_notes: DoorDash (U.S.). Membership runs until December 31, 2029 or for 12 months from activation, whichever is longer. Activate by December 31, 2029. Must use the enrolled Sapphire Reserve card as the payment method at DoorDash checkout. U.S. address required.

rules.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
rules.eligibility_notes: Primary cardmember only; the card must remain open. Valid through 12/31/2027 while the card remains open. Link an IHG One Rewards account on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app. Activation can take up to 3 weeks.

rules.name: Priority Pass Select lounge membership
rules.eligibility_notes: Physical Priority Pass card or the Priority Pass digital card is required for entry; digital wallet cards are not accepted. Additional guests beyond two are charged $27 per guest per visit. Ongoing while the card is open. Chase states Priority Pass Select is automatically activated for primary cardmembers and authorized users.

rules.name: $500 Southwest Airlines credit via Chase Travel ($75,000 spend tier)
rules.eligibility_notes: Southwest Airlines purchases booked through Chase Travel. Any portion of a purchase covered by the credit does not earn points. Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Up to $500 in statement credits per qualifying period, expiring at the end of the calendar year following the qualifying year. If the cardmember qualifies in consecutive years, the most available at one time is $1,000. Applied automatically. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear. Unlocks after $75,000 of spend (calendar year); counting rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count.

rules.name: World of Hyatt Explorist status ($75,000 spend tier)
rules.eligibility_notes: Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Chase may remove tier benefits for misuse. Status lasts through the remainder of the qualifying calendar year, the following calendar year, and through February of the calendar year after that. Link a World of Hyatt account on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app. Allow up to 3 weeks for activation. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear. Unlocks after $75,000 of spend (calendar year); counting rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Status lasts through the remainder of the qualifying calendar year and the following calendar year. Link an IHG One Rewards account; if Platinum Elite status is already active through the card, Diamond Elite activates automatically. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear. Unlocks after $75,000 of spend (calendar year); counting rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. rules.name: Southwest Airlines A-List status ($75,000 spend tier)
rules.eligibility_notes: Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Chase may remove tier benefits for misuse. Status lasts through December 31 of the calendar year following the qualifying year. Link a Southwest Rapid Rewards membership number. Allow 10 to 15 business days for activation. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear. Unlocks after $75,000 of spend (calendar year); counting rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement.
